goal: Sustained wall-clock useful-work coverage >=93.33% with substantive durable-evidence gaps <=120s.

active_interventions.expected_effect: Prevent voluntary early return after objective/checkpoint completion.
Exploit long healthy invocations while preserving a future same-canonical recovery wake.
Provide independent fast replacement after abrupt platform boundary.
Bound stale-owner rescue emission once event consumer exists.
Prevent heartbeat-only writes from laundering idle time into useful-work coverage.
Treat user-visible final as a run-ending side effect and deny it while CONTINUE/DEGRADED_CONTINUATION remains owned without committed handoff/operator stop/platform boundary.

live_interpretation: The 01:00-01:15 window had enough endpoint coverage for 94.67%, but the stronger audit found one 125-second gap between substantive durable commits after excluding ACTIVITY-only heartbeats. Because the acceptance limit is 120 seconds, the earlier PASS is revoked. This is a near-pass by 5 seconds, not a target achievement.
dominant_risks: Substantive evidence cadence must stay <=120 seconds without manufacturing busywork.
Independent fast replacement after platform-forced disappearance remains unavailable.
Work event trigger is not provisioned and Codex Cloud is not connected.
Model/runtime may still terminate outside repository control; such disappearance must be recovered by an independent wake path rather than mistaken for an authorized final.
next_decision: On every live owner, require a fresh pre-final gate immediately before any final. If denied, continue useful work; an armed quarter wake is cold rescue only and never permission to idle.
